verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail publishes a $20 per-check deposit fee. It names Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase and Wells Fargo as getting complimentary overnight shipping. It also states the physical check is mailed directly to your bank of deposit, which answers what happens to the check. However, it never says which banks are supported overall or how long processing takes before the check ships. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported banks (beyond the three named for free overnight shipping), a published end-to-end turnaround time for deposits, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, check deposit terms are published — supported banks, per-deposit fees, turnaround time, and what happens to the physical check afterward

citations.quote: $20 per check; complimentary overnight shipping is provided for checks deposited into accounts with Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase, and Wells Fargo.
Deposit checks into your bank account by having the checks mailed directly to your bank of deposit.
Checks forwarded directly to your bank so you can get paid faster (additional fees apply)
